premise: Sela Wynn, a diver with expertise in buoyancy, decompression and noninvasive survey, must recover archival evidence without damaging a protected ruin before volcanic ash reaches the cliffside signal tower.

The cliffside signal tower becomes inaccessible beyond basalt islands
